Topics · Hard times

What does God do with grief that never settles?

The Quran hurries no one out of grief. A father's eyes whitened and he went to God. Ease comes with hardship.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ٨٤ قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَـٰلِكِينَ٨٥ قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ٨٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white[614] from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.[615] They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish." He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.

Translator's notes

[614] i.e., he lost his sight. [615] He did not express the extent of his grief or his anger at what he suspected his sons had done but was patient, depending only upon Allāh for help.

Quran · Yusuf 12:84-86

Translation

I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

Original · Hebrew

ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃ אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃ בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

the Psalms · 142:1-3

World English Bible

The Quran does not hurry anyone out of grief. Here it tells of a father who lost a son and whose eyes turned white with sorrow. He held it in and did not pretend. His family told him to let go. He answered that he was bringing his sorrow and his grief to God. A sorrow that never settles is allowed to be brought exactly as it is, with no deadline.

A question for you

What do the people around you do with a sorrow that does not end?

If you sayThey tell me to move on.
ThenThe passage shows a man told the same thing, and a text that does not join the speakers.
If you sayThey avoid it.
ThenSilence around grief is lonely. The passage shows a grief spoken to One who listens.
If you sayThey sit with me.
ThenThat is a rare gift. The next passage speaks of One who does not leave.

Part 2 of 3

﴿مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ٣ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ٤ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you]. And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]. And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

Quran · Ad-Duha 93:3-5

Translation

Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

Original · Hebrew

וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃ וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

the Psalms · 9:9-10

World English Bible

This passage was said first to the Prophet, and many in grief have taken it for themselves. It says: your Lord has not left you and has not turned away in dislike. Then it promises that the last will be better for you than the first, and that you will be given until you are content. It does not say the sorrow is small. It says the sorrow is not the end of the story and that the One who made you has not turned away.

A question for you

Which would help more: that the sorrow ends, or that it is heard?

If you sayThat it ends.
ThenIt is natural to wish for that. The passage gives no date, but it does say the last is better than the first.
If you sayThat it is heard.
ThenThat is what the verses describe: a Lord who has not left you.
If you sayBoth.
ThenThe verses hold room for both: hearing now, and a promise of what comes after.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا٥ إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief]. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

Quran · Ash-Sharh 94:5-6

Translation

Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me. Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit. Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name. For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

Original · Hebrew

יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֑י שִׁוַּ֥עְתִּי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵֽנִי׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מִיָּֽרְדִי־בֽוֹר׃ זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע ׀ בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃

the Psalms · 30:2-5

World English Bible

These two verses are small in words and large in grammar. They say: with hardship comes ease. The word is 'with', not 'after'. The ease is not waiting at the far end of the sorrow. It travels inside it, often unseen. A sorrow that never settles can still have beside it something that is not sorrow: a hand, a meal, a morning. Nothing here says the sorrow must be made smaller.

A question for you

What was beside your hardest time?

If you sayA person.
ThenOne person can be the 'with' in the verse.
If you sayA small routine.
ThenSmall routines carry a person when nothing else does.
If you sayI cannot see it yet.
ThenYou need not find it now. The Quran says it is there. It does not ask you to feel it today.

The same in the other books

Translation

Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture. Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart. Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

Original · Hebrew

בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃ וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃ גּ֣וֹל עַל־יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃ וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

the Psalms · 37:3-6

World English Bible

Translation

But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me. Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

וַאֲנִי֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י יִשְׁמָעֵ֖נִי אֱלֹהָֽי׃ אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֨בְתִּי֙ לִ֔י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽי׃

Who could you tell the whole of your sorrow to, without being rushed?
